import os, stat
from pathlib import Path
src = Path('src')
total = 0
count = 0
for base, dirs, names in os.walk(src, followlinks=False):
    rel = Path(base).relative_to(src)
    for name in sorted(dirs + names):
        p = Path(base)/name
        st = p.lstat()
        count += 1
        assert count <= 128, 'entry bound'
        if stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode):
            continue
        assert stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) and st.st_nlink == 1, f'not regular {p}'
        total += st.st_size
        p.read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
print('entries:', count, 'bytes:', total)
EOF
